relevance_note: Review of published HA20 patients ("In this review, we summarize the characteristics of patients with HA20 in East Asia") that gives individual-level facts for five previously published patients in the text, e.g. "The first case of allogeneic HCT was a 14-year-old English boy."
method_note: Review; Table 1 gives only group counts (74 East Asian patients in 39 families, 51 other-region patients in 23 families), so no rows come from it and n_patients_reported/cohort_size_as_stated are left null (no single total is stated; 74 and 51 are stated separately). Individuals are only the previously published people the text gives individual-level facts for: ref (10) Hodgkin lymphoma patient; ref (47) East Asian patient with elevated ISG expression; ref (30) autologous-HCT patient with CNS vasculitis; and the two allogeneic-HCT cases (14-year-old English boy, 6-year-old Japanese boy), both cited only by the combined citation '(31, 47)', so they are labelled 'ref (31, 47) patient' and 'ref (31, 47) patient 2' and source_reference_in_review is the combined '(31, 47)'. The paper's other statements suggest, but do not state, that the English boy is from (31) (allogeneic HCT in one patient in other regions, rituximab (10, 31, 41)) and the Japanese boy from (47) (only East Asian canakinumab patient (47)); the ref (47) ISG-expression patient is probably the same person as the Japanese boy, but the paper does not say so, so they are kept as separate rows for downstream reconciliation. Treatment-only mentions (e.g. the single East Asian canakinumab patient (47), not effective) are not separate rows (no sex, age, variant or feature). Variants mentioned with references (Cys243Tyr (45), Glu192Lys (18), Met476Ile (20), Arg183X in two families (22, 27), Arg87X (21, 42), p.Asn102Ser, c.487-1G>A, p.Val309dup, Phe127Cys polymorphism) are not tied to any individual described here, so the variants table is empty. Ages '14-year-old' and '6-year-old' are recorded as age at last evaluation/report, though they may be the age at HCT. 'cell depletion', 'hepatitis', 'enteropathy' and 'bowel disease' are recorded as stated; their checklist items (cytopenia (autoimmune), autoimmune hepatitis, gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation) are left not reported because the paper does not specify them. 'insulin-dependent DM' is taken as type 1 diabetes; psoriasis as a skin lesion; Hodgkin lymphoma not taken as lymphoproliferation. The ref (30) patient's disease label is left not reported because the sentence itself does not name HA20 (context: Treatment of HA20 section). No contradictions found. JSON built with a short script in scratch; values transcribed by hand from my reading.
